frequency_question: How often do such highly partisan electoral bills successfully pass the Senate?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone federal voting bills focused on voter ID, registration documentation, or federal election administration that became major partisan flashpoints. Excludes routine appropriations or non-controversial bipartisan technical corrections.

cases.name: National Voter Registration Act Amendments / Voter ID Push (various failed attempts)

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major partisan federal voting reform efforts named; all failed to pass the Senate in their standalone or primary partisan forms due to filibuster or chamber division.
known_gaps: Minor variations of riders attached to omnibus appropriations are excluded, focusing on standalone or primary partisan vehicles.
validity_reason: Valid until the conclusion of the current congressional composition cycle and major Senate filibuster rule dynamics.
